name: Sylvan Learning Center
description: Sylvan Learning Centers are a well-established network of supplemental education and tutoring centers focused on providing personalized instruction for students in grades K-12. Founded in 1979 in Portland, Oregon, Sylvan Learning (officially Sylvan Learning, Inc.) began as a company offering individualized tutoring and has grown into one of the leading providers in the field. It operates through a combination of franchised and corporate-owned locations, with more than 500+ centers worldwide (primarily in the United States), though the exact number fluctuates around 700-750 points of presence in recent years. The centers specialize in personalized learning programs tailored to each child's needs, using an initial assessment (often called the Insight™ Assessment) to identify strengths and gaps. Tutors—typically expert educators familiar with local school curricula—create customized learning plans. Core subjects include: Reading and writing Mathematics Study skills Homework support Test preparation (for college entrance exams like the SAT/ACT, as well as state exams) Many locations also offer enrichment programs to help students get ahead. Sylvan emphasizes a blended approach, often incorporating technology like their proprietary SylvanSync™ system (interactive lessons on tablets/iPads) alongside one-on-one or small-group instruction in a supportive environment. The goal is to build academic confidence, ignite curiosity, and inspire a love for learning, with reported results showing students achieving noticeable improvements in grades, test scores, and up to 3x more growth in math/reading compared to peers in some cases. As a franchise-based model (now under parent company Unleashed Brands), individual centers are locally owned and operated but follow Sylvan's proven methods and curriculum. They serve millions of families over the decades and position themselves as a results-oriented alternative to traditional schooling support, with options for in-center, online, or hybrid tutoring in many areas.

name: Read/Read Foundational Language Support
description: At Read/Read Foundational Language Support, we believe that strong reading and language skills are the foundation of lifelong learning — and that support should meet each learner where they are. Our mission is to empower individuals of all ages to become confident, fluent, and empowered readers and writers. What We Do Personalized reading & language instruction — We provide structured, systematic support in foundational literacy: phonemic awareness, phonics, decoding, word recognition, spelling, reading fluency, and comprehension. Writing & written language support — We help learners strengthen spelling, handwriting, sentence and paragraph writing, grammar, vocabulary, and overall written expression. Comprehension & language development — Beyond decoding and writing, we support vocabulary development, oral language, grammar, syntax, and comprehension — helping learners build a deep, nuanced understanding of language. Individualized tutoring & remediation / enrichment — Whether someone is just beginning to learn reading and writing, bridging gaps due to learning differences, or seeking advanced enrichment, our instruction is tailored to their specific level and goals. Support for diverse learners — We welcome students with a variety of learning profiles — including those who struggle with reading or writing, those with learning differences (such as dyslexia), and those who simply wish to improve their fluency, comprehension and confidence. Lifelong learning — We serve a broad age range — children learning to read for the first time, older students needing remediation, teens or adults working on language skills, or any individual wanting to sharpen reading and writing abilities. Why It Matters Reading and writing are more than academic skills — they are tools for communication, learning, and opportunity. Without a secure foundation in phonics, decoding, spelling, and language comprehension, many learners struggle to keep up academically or to express themselves effectively. At Read/Read Foundational Language Support, we use evidence-based, systematic methods to build these foundational skills in a supportive, learner-centered environment. The result is not just improved reading or writing — but confidence, independence, and a love for learning. Who We Serve Children and early readers building foundational reading and writing skills. Students who experience difficulties with reading, spelling, writing, or comprehension — including those with learning differences. Teens and adults who want to improve or remediate language, reading, or writing skills. Families seeking individualized, one-on-one (or small-group) instruction tailored to their child’s pace and needs. Our Approach & Values Individualized & learner-centered — We assess each learner’s strengths and challenges to tailor instruction to their needs. Structured, research-informed methods — Our instruction is systematic, sequential, and based on foundational literacy principles. Respect, empathy, and patience — Learning to read, write, or re-learn language skills can be challenging. We meet each learner with care, understanding, and respect for their journey. Holistic language development — We see reading and writing as part of a broader language system: decoding, comprehension, expression, vocabulary, and confidence.

Our Mission We support families of children with learning challenges and disabilities, through, Direct Tutorial Services, Parent Liaison Services, Child Care Training & Support, as well as various projects that promotes community involvement. Our purpose is to eliminate barriers by providing access to equity to those that learn in unique ways. Theory of Impact Through the supports provided through collaboratives communities, homes, schools and the workplace we are able to develop an ecosystem of sustainability that will support the development of individuals who may learn uniquely. Our Values Every individual deserves the opportunity to reach their full potential. We believe that an individual born with or has experienced environmental stimulus to depict learning challenges is not at the fault of the individual. We believe that when the right resources are provided any individual can obtain a life towards independence and equity

name: Kumon Math And Reading Center Of Katy - Cinco Ranch East
description: Kumon is a global after-school educational program that develops math and reading skills through individualized, self-paced learning. Students begin with a placement test to determine their starting level, which may be below or above their school grade to ensure a solid foundation. Daily practice, typically 15–30 minutes per subject, is completed at home, while students visit a Kumon center twice a week for guidance and progress evaluation. Worksheets are designed in small incremental steps, helping students master each concept before moving on to more advanced topics. The program covers math from basic counting to calculus and reading from letter recognition to advanced literature.

name: Williams Therapy Services
description: Williams Therapy Services, Inc. (“WTS”) is a licensed outpatient pediatric and adult therapy provider offering speech therapy and occupational therapy. WTS delivers services that directly support a child’s ability to access learning, participate in classroom tasks, and succeed academically and socially. WTS provides services on campus, in clinic and via teletherapy when appropriate. WTS will make the following services available to students using TEFA funds: - Speech therapy assessments and treatment - Occupational therapy assessments and treatment - Functional academic skill support when deficits are therapy-related (e.g., handwriting, sensory regulation, motor planning, communication) - Parent/caregiver training and education to support carryover - Collaboration with teachers and educational teams to align goals with school participation - Documentation of progress, goals, therapeutic plan, and measurable outcomes - Other specialty areas: hand therapy, handwriting, dysgraphia therapy, dyslexia therapy, feeding therapy and swallowing therapy.

name: Bay Area Christian School
description:
Bay Area Christian School exists to provide quality, Kingdom education to the next generation, empowering them to make disciples of Jesus at home, in society, and through the church.
BACS seeks those students and families who embrace a rigorous academic schedule and Christian values - all while meeting a high standard of achievement and conduct.

To be admitted, the student must not have more than one failing grade for the previous semester and must have a discipline record free of major infractions.

Christian values are encouraged through daily Bible class for all students, weekly chapel, Scripture memory, Christ-centered curriculum, Christian teachers as role models, and outstanding Christian leaders as guest speakers.
